content: Jisas dikidiy waraga duw.
Kidiy duw, Jisas Krais, God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duw, dikidiy waraga duwadiy. Jisas dikidi waraga duw, David. David dikidi waraga duw, Aparam.
Aparam, Aysak dikidi asaay-ad. Aysak, Jakap dikidi asaay-ad. Jakap, Juwtawa dikidiy mwamugwawa nyamwusugw dayadi asaay-ad.
Juwta, Pirisawa Sira birakidi asaay-ad. Biraki amaay, Tama. Piris, Yisran dikidi asaay-ad. Yisran, Aram dikidi asaay-ad.
Aram, Aminatap dikidi asaay-ad. Aminatap, Nasan dikidi asaay-ad. Nasan, Salman dikidi asaay-ad.
Salman, Bawas dikidi asaay-ad. Bawas diki amaay, Rayap. Bawas, Awpit dikidi asaay-ad. Awpit diki amaay, Ruwit. Awpit, Jisiy dikidi asaay-ad.
Jisiy, Yisrayil dayadi yitaypika duw Davit, dikidi asaay-ad. Davit Salaman dikidi asaay-ad. Salaman diki amaay tayir Yuwraya diki taakw tikuw, Davit ata liydil diki taakw tilikikik.
Salaman, Riyapawam dikidi asaay-ad. Riyapawam, Apija dikidi asaay-ad. Apija, Asa dikidi asaay-ad.
Asa, Jiyasapat dikidi asaay-ad. Jiyasapat, Jawram dikidi asaay-ad. Jawram, Yuwsaya dikidi asaay-ad.
Yuwsaya, Jatam dikidi asaay-ad. Jatam, Ayas dikidi asaay-ad. Ayas, Yisikaya dikidi asaay-ad.
Yisikaya, Manasa dikidi asaay-ad. Manasa, Amas dikidi asaay-ad. Amas, Jawsaya dikidi asaay-adki taakw tikuw, Davit ata liydil diki taakw tilikikik.

Jawsaya, Jikanayawa dikidiy nyamwusugw dayadi asaay-ad. A nyaam Yisrayil dayadiy mama nibak, Bapilan jaka tipa kidiy duw, dayawa wariyakuw, kakilkuw, day abab Yisrayil jaka tipa kidiy duw taakw kwurin karaydadiy dayadi nimadi tip Bapilanaar.
Bapilanaar yikuw, Jikanaya, Siyaltiyal dikidi asaay-ad. Siyaltiyal, Sirapapal dikidi asaay-ad.
Sirapapal, Apiyad dikidi asaay-ad. Apiyad, Aliyakim dikidi asaay-ad. Aliyakim, Asar dikidi asaay-ad.
Asar, Satak dikidi asaay-ad. Satak, Akim dikidi asaay-ad. Akim, Aliyuwut dikidi asaay-ad.
Aliyuwut, Aliyasa dikidi asaay-ad. Aliyasa, Matan dikidi asaay-ad. Matan, Jakap dikidi asaay-ad.
Jakap, Jawsip dikidi asaay-ad. Jawsip diki taakw Maria. Maria, Jisas, God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duw diki amaaya.

Nyan nasiyibana Aparam duw nak, aw dikidi nyan Aysak duw vitiy, Aparam dikidi gwaal Jakap duw mugwul, Aparam dikidi warag Jawsip duw aliy. Atawada nasiyibana aka yin aw Aparam dikidi warag Davit ab sayna. Day abab duw tabatiy maan aliy-adiy. Atampik Davit maa nasiyibanaad duw nak, Davit dikidi nyan Salaman duw vitiy, Davit dikidi gwaal Riyapawam duw mugwul, Davit dikidi warag Apija duw aliy. Atawada nasiyibana aka yin aw Davit dikidi warag Jikanaya. A nyab Bapilan tipa kidiy duw Yisrayil tipa kidiy duw takwaam kwurin karaydadiy Bapilan tipaar. Day abab duw tabatiy maan aliy-adiy. A nyab nasiyibana aka aw yaan Jisas, day abab duw tabatiy maan aliy-adiy.
Kitawa Maria God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duw Jisas sapwiylid.

Maria bas Jisas, God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duw, kitawa sapwiylid. Maria li Jawsipak wadaak, li duwawa maa ti. Li kip wiyaam kwaal dikik. Atawa kwalik, God dikidi Mawul dakuw, nyan ata bas yalaam yitakadid.

Maria li Jawsipak wadaak, kwaal wiyab dikik rikir. Jawsip di viyakita duwad. Aw di wukidil Maria yalawa tilik, aw mawulaar wukikuw, “Nikidi duw likim vaal yidil” waan, aw di likik wukid ata wap sayik-na. Alik di diki mawulab likim wapaak pakwun tad.

Ata ki javik wukin tidik, Yitaypika Duw God diki maaj kaldadi duw Jawsipak yiginim wadid “Jawsip, Davit dikidi waraga duw, min yaga-tikwa Mariaam kira-kirak. Kidi liki yalaam tinadi nyan, aad God dikidi Mawulaar yitakadidi Nyan-ad likim. Aw li duwa nyanad sapwiy-kilaad. Di dikidiy gwalugwa duw taakw dayadiy vaal yibwiykuw, nyigil-kidadiy. Alik Jisas asikiytak dikik.” Jisas maw maaj Nyigildi Duw-ad.
Mwiya tayir Yitaypika Duw God diki maaj wasapwiydi duw maaj sukwudil ki javik. Di waad,

content.text: “Ginyir taakw nak duwawa ti maarkuw, kip yalawa tikuw, duwa nyan sapwiy-kilaad. Adi nyinik Yimanuwal waan sikiytaka-kidanaad.”

content: Adi si maw maaj kitawa wana: God nyanawa tinaad. Ki maaj aka bwutaay mwiya mwiyaba maaj tina.
Aw Jawsip jawiyakuw, adi God diki maaj kardadi duw wadil majib wukikuw, di Maria kiradil.
Aw Jawsip likiwa kisab maa kwar. Kip kwurin kwadik, adi Nyan ata sapwiylid. Sapwiylik, Jawsip ata Jisas waan sikiytaka-did adi nyinik.
